subject: Stitchless close playbook: MSA / DPA / Order form timing and sequencing
messages:
From: Dana Li <dana.li@medalign.com>
To: karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: MedAlign Procurement <procurement@medalign.com>
Date: Mon, 23 Feb 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Sequencing ask: MSA/DPA/order form — tight window

Hi Karthik / Laura,

Thanks again for the demo last week. Procurement has a hard gating date on our side: board approval meeting on Mar 12. They need a clear sequencing plan (who reviews what and when) so they can route approvals and get budget signed.

High-level asks from MedAlign:
- A one-page MAP showing legal vs procurement vs technical milestones for signature (MSA -> DPA -> Order Form).
- Typical review durations for each step (Redwood internal + MedAlign internal).
- Any common sticking points you see (SLA, data residency, vendor risk items) and recommended mitigations so we can present to the board.

Can you send a draft MAP and a proposed timeline by end of week? Procurement copied here; they may add constraints.

Thanks,
Dana

--
Dana Li
Head of Strategic Sourcing
MedAlign Therapeutics
Phone: +1 415-555-0148

From: karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Dana Li <dana.li@medalign.com>, laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, rachel_kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Feb 2026 10:38:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Sequencing ask: MSA/DPA/order form — tight window

Dana — thanks for the clear asks. Attached is a first-pass "Stitchless MAP" that splits responsibilities and shows a 3-week compressed cadence aimed at a Mar 12 signature window. Attachment: Stitchless_MAP_v1.xlsx (MAP + milestone swimlanes).

Summary of the plan (high level):
- Week 1 (Feb 25 - Mar 3): Redwood legal redlines MSA/DPA (internal) + MedAlign legal concurrent review kickoff. Order form draft (pricing + usage tiers) circulated to procurement.
- Week 2 (Mar 4 - Mar 10): MedAlign legal returns redlines; joint triage session to resolve blockable items. Procurement runs PO/terms check.
- Week 3 (Mar 11 - Mar 12): Final sign-off window for execs; go/no-go decision at board meeting.

Key assumptions / risks:
- If DPA review extends beyond Week 2 we recommend parallelizing technical onboarding (sandbox access) to avoid slippage.
- SLA/scoped incident response/retention windows are the most frequent negotiation points; I noted suggested compromise language in the MAP.

Immediate asks for medalign:
1) Can procurement confirm internal reviewer names and expected review lead times? (we used conservative 48-72h durations in the draft)
2) Any absolute no-change items for you (e.g., minimum retention, certification requirements)?

I can join procurement kickoff meeting Thursday if that helps.

Regards,
Karthik
Director, GTM Ops — Redwood Inference
Attachment: Stitchless_MAP_v1.xlsx (sheet: swimlanes + assumptions)

Karthik / Dana — added legal commentary and a conservative sequencing refinement. See attached DPA redlines (DPA_redlines_mar2026.docx) and a short note on the order form timeline.

Quoted below for context: 
> From: karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
> Date: Wed, 25 Feb 2026 10:38:00 -0800
> Subject: Re: Sequencing ask: MSA/DPA/order form — tight window
> 
> Dana — thanks for the clear asks. Attached is a first-pass "Stitchless MAP" ...

Laura's clarifications / recommended cadence:
- Legal redlines: Redwood internal turnaround: 48 hours; MedAlign legal assumed 72 hours. If MedAlign returns redlines earlier we can compress by 2 days.
- DPA-specific: propose we lock data residency and subprocessor list by Mar 5. Anything after that becomes an addendum to avoid delaying signature.
- Order Form: pricing and seat counts must be finalized by Mar 7 to enable procurement PO processing. If procurement needs an extra routing step, we need the PO approver list by Mar 3.

Concrete attachments: DPA_redlines_mar2026.docx (tracked changes) and OrderForm_v0.3.pdf (pricing snapshot).

Next steps I propose:
1) Joint kickoff (30m) Thu Mar 4 10:00 PST — legal + procurement + Karthik. Laura and I will run triage.
2) Karthik to update MAP with locked dates for DPA/orderform and post to shared Drive.

If MedAlign can confirm the procurement approver list and any calendar blackouts by EOD Mon Mar 1 we can keep to the Mar 12 window.

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Sr. Counsel, Contracts — Redwood Inference
Attachments: DPA_redlines_mar2026.docx, OrderForm_v0.3.pdf
